Stripe._comment: Use TEST MODE keys only (sk_test_... / pk_test_...) from https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/apikeys — never live keys. No real card is ever charged.

Copilot._comment: Provider: 'AzureOpenAI' (free 30-day trial credit), 'GitHubModels' (free tier, no time limit), or 'Ollama' (fully local, $0 forever). See docs/ROADMAP.md. EmbeddingDeploymentName/EmbeddingModel power RAG search over KnowledgeArticles (VECTOR(1536) column — keep to a 1536-dim embedding model, e.g. text-embedding-3-small).

Ollama._embeddingComment: Most local embedding models are NOT 1536-dim (e.g. nomic-embed-text is 768) — see docs/ROADMAP.md before relying on RAG with Ollama.
